title: Bind installed gateway OSCORE contexts to canonical peer IDs
description: Security review of the new runtime GCP dispatch found Gateway::install_gcp_context accepts an arbitrary Context for a pinned public key without validating the context's sender/recipient IDs or detecting seven-byte OSCORE-ID collisions. A caller could associate the wrong traffic keys/identity with a durable pin. Require canonical local/peer seven-byte IDs, reject colliding full IIDs, and test fail-closed installation.
close_reason: Already implemented. Gateway::install_gcp_context (rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:985) requires the context's sender_id/recipient_id to equal the canonical seven-byte OSCORE IDs derived from local_iid/peer_iid (gateway.rs:1003-1004 area), rejecting non-canonical bindings; truncated/colliding OSCORE IDs are rejected with GatewayOscoreStoreError::IdCollision (gateway.rs:1244-1259, truncation forbidden per gateway.rs:1484). Regression: truncated_oscore_id_collision_is_rejected (gateway.rs:2461). Full lichen-gateway suite green this session.
